simple.meaning: עֲקַלְקַל (ʻăqalqal) is a Hebrew word meaning “winding.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: עֲקַלְקַל (H6128) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Judges 5:6, with occurrences in Judges, Psalms.
